gloss: to threaten; to intimidate; to menace

definitions.gloss: to threaten; to intimidate; to menace; to coerce
definitions.explanation: To use threats of harm or negative consequences to frighten someone or force them into compliance.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{脅|おど}してはいけない。
{彼|かれ}はナイフで{店員|てんいん}を{脅|おど}した。
examples.english: He threatened the store clerk with a knife.

examples.japanese: {秘密|ひみつ}をばらすと{脅|おど}されて、{仕方|しかた}なく{従|したが}った。
examples.english: Threatened with having a secret exposed, I had no choice but to comply.

notes:
A godan verb conjugating with the す row ({脅|おど}す → {脅|おど}して → {脅|おど}した). This is the more colloquial word for threatening, compared to the formal {脅迫|きょうはく}する.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: XがYを{脅|おど}す

ASPECT (ている):
- Type: Atelic (ongoing action)
- {脅|おど}している = is threatening / is in the process of threatening

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xを{脅|おど}す: to threaten X (the person being threatened)
- Xで{脅|おど}す: to threaten with X (the weapon or means used)
- ～と{脅|おど}す: to threaten that... (content of the threat)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナイフで{脅|おど}す: to threaten with a knife
- {金|かね}を{出|だ}せと{脅|おど}す: to threaten someone to hand over money
- {殺|ころ}すと{脅|おど}す: to threaten to kill
- {脅|おど}して{金|かね}を{奪|うば}う: to take money by intimidation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {脅|おびや}かす: to threaten; to endanger — focuses more on creating a sense of danger or insecurity; more literary
- {脅迫|きょうはく}する: to threaten; to coerce — the formal/legal term for making threats
- {威嚇|いかく}する: to intimidate; to menace — emphasizes a display of power to frighten
- {恐喝|きょうかつ}する: to blackmail; to extort — specifically involves demanding money through threats

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {脅|おど}していませんでした
